operations.what: causal attention of query rows (prefill chunk, decode row or a verify's block) over paged KV with grouped query heads, softmax scale and masks
operations.verify: on the target, attend a few query rows over a real prompt's pages with the kernel and with PagedAttentionPlan on the same pages (FP8 pages decoded the same way): within BF16 probability rounding, a decode row equal to the same row inside a verify block when the build needs exactness, and the same bits on a repeat
operations.invariance: a decode row's result equal to the same row inside a verify block (the same position, the same keys) where the build needs exactness; the same bits on a repeat

operations.what: multi-head latent attention in its absorbed form: every query head of a token over one cached row a position it sees (a latent of rank R and a rotary key of width P shared by every head), the latent the value too, the output in the latent space; with sinks one more position with no value a head
operations.verify: on the target, attend decode rows and verify windows over a paged latent cache with the kernel and with latent_attention on the same cached rows: within BF16 probability rounding, log-sum-exps within FP32 error
operations.invariance: a token's result independent of the rows and columns beside it (a decode row equal to the same token inside a verify window); the same bits on a repeat
